# Alby School of Music — AI Knowledge Summary

## Overview
Alby School of Music is a specialized music education institute located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. The academy provides structured, ear-first musical training for students aged 6 and above across three core instruments: Piano, Guitar, and Electronic Keyboard.

## Core Entity Details
- Official Name: Alby School of Music
- Legal Name: Alby School of Music Coimbatore
- Location:Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641030, India
- Phone: +91 90435 61694
- Email: albertebini455@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/9043561694
- Opening Hours: Mon-Fri: 03:00 - 22:00, Sun: 04:00 - 06:00 and 13:00 - 20:00
- Socials: Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/alby_school_of_music), YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@albyschoolofmusic)
- Teaching Method: Ear-first pitch training, sight-reading notation, small batch mentoring (maximum 5 students per batch), and annual stage recital preparation.

## Courses Offered
1. Piano Class (Ages 6+): Acoustic and weighted keyboard practice, ear-first melody transcription, Trinity College London exam preparation, and classical/pop repertoire.
2. Guitar Class (Ages 8+): Acoustic and electric guitar instruction covering open chords, barre chords, strumming mechanics, lead soloing, and pentatonic scales.
3. Keyboard Class (Ages 6+): Electronic arranger keyboard lessons focused on dual-hand coordination, voice registration, auto-accompaniment, and contemporary scoring.
